results.detail: Manifest identity and self-exclusion are explicit.
Adapter declares exact HTTPS authority, cleared environment, redirect limit, and proxy suppression.
Static credential design separates ciphertext record from Keychain material and does not declare a plaintext column.
Static state machine separates test, selection, enablement, and fixed-canary send.
UI static scan finds Tauri invoke boundary and no direct browser network primitive.
Fixed candidate must support a fresh review-owned root without touching the retained Phase-B root.
Review-owned temporary-root marker is a 0600 regular file.
